systems.system: Système d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil
systems.owner: BUNEC supervises; mayors and their deputies are the civil registration officers
systems.tiers: 2,875 civil registration centres: 419 principal centres in communes, communautés urbaines and consular posts, and 2,455 secondary centres; data collection is manual and on paper, and three centres in five function, as of August 2023

note: Passages of the statistics institute's August 2023 report on civil registration statistics: it describes civil registration in the communes as collected by hand on paper and recommends computerised systems; that is the state of an application, and nothing is stated about whether a commune office has a connection.
